if (temp < dist[e->to]) { dist[e->to] = temp; parent[e->to] = e; que.push({temp, e->to}); } } } } if (parent[snk] == nullptr) break; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (parent[i] != nullptr) { potential[i] += dist[i]; } } long long augFlow = LLONG_MAX; for (int i = snk; i != src; i = parent[i]->from) { augFlow = min(augFlow, parent[i]->remaining()); } for (int i = snk; i != src; i = parent[i]->from) { Edge* e = parent[i]; e->addFlow(augFlow); cost += augFlow * e->cost; } flow += augFlow; } minCost = cost; return flow; } }; class FastScanner { private: istream& in; public: FastScanner(istream& input) : in(input) {} FastScanner() : in(cin) {} string next() { string s;
